title: Jim Jordan floats Sen. Dave McCormick for president in 2028
text:
DALLAS — Rep. Jim Jordan (R-OH) said on Wednesday that first-term Sen. Dave McCormick (R-PA) could be a “good person” to run for the GOP presidential nomination in 2028.

Jordan made the comments during an interview with the Washington Examiner at the Republican midterm convention in Dallas, Texas. Specifically, Jordan was asked for his views on a potential White House run by Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX), who has said he plans to be involved in any discussion about who succeeds President Donald Trump.
